concerns.location: tasks.md:T005 [P] tag vs Execution order note
concerns.text: T005 is tagged [P] (parallel-safe) yet the Execution order section itself states "T005's training loop depends on T003's graphs". A task with a declared producer dependency cannot be parallel-safe; either remove the [P] tag from T005 or split the model/runtime-guard implementation (parallel-safe) from the training-loop wiring (depends on T003).

T002 is tagged [P] but its verification requires `pytest tests/contract/test_dataset_schema.py` and row validation "against contracts/materials_dataset.schema.yaml" — an artifact produced by T001. T002 consumes T001's contract, so the [P] tag is unsafe as written; T002 should be sequenced after T001 or the [P] removed.

T008's execution order says it "requires T007's checkpoints (fixture checkpoints for unit tests)", but T006 — the only pre-T007 end-to-end run — never states it saves checkpoints under outputs/. When the study is gated, T008's unit tests have no declared producer. Add an explicit checkpoint-saving step to T006 (fixture checkpoints, clearly labeled non-study) so the T008 dependency is satisfiable in the gated path.
